items.section: OcclusionQuery: current contract and render-pass limit
items.text: Vulkan occlusion queries record only the first contiguous run of tagged draws per frame; draws after a render-pass boundary inside one Begin/End span are not summed.

items.section: OcclusionQuery: current contract and render-pass limit
items.text: On VULKAN only 3D draws are tagged with the active OcclusionQuery; SpriteBatch draws between Begin and End do not contribute to PixelCount.

items.section: Render-target mipmaps, MSAA, and viewport
items.text: An enabled zero-area ScissorRectangle draws unclipped on VULKAN and SDL_GPU (expanded to the full target) but clips everything on WEBGPU and suppresses the draw on METAL.

items.section: Two corrected render-target black-frame defects
items.text: CNA's docs/rendertarget-support.md still lists implemented Vulkan render-target features (mips, MSAA, viewport, black-frame defects) as open (documentation staleness inside CNA).

items.section: SwapInterval to VkPresentModeKHR: the same three-way switch Chapter ch:game-loop introduced
items.text: No test times the real cadence of Vulkan present modes; FIFO_RELAXED late-frame behaviour is the specification's contract only.

items.section: BlendState: native mapping and historical defect
items.text: Vulkan applied one hard-coded NonPremultiplied blend equation whenever blending was on (Task 868).

items.section: Stencil testing: another discarded-parameter defect
items.text: Vulkan ApplyDepthStencilState discarded every stencil parameter and never enabled the stencil test (Task 870).

items.section: Stencil testing: another discarded-parameter defect
items.text: Vulkan device-wide depth format preferred the stencil-less D32_SFLOAT, so stencil almost never worked.

items.section: OcclusionQuery: current contract and render-pass limit
items.text: Vulkan occlusion queries were disconnected from deferred draw submission and always reported zero.

items.section: Remaining limitation
items.text: Extreme RasterizerState.DepthBias produced no visible bias on Vulkan (recorded as an unresolved observation).

items.section: Two corrected render-target black-frame defects
items.text: A Vulkan render target cleared and unbound without a draw stayed black (never recorded).

items.section: Two corrected render-target black-frame defects
items.text: A Vulkan RenderTargetCube filled by SpriteBatch and sampled through EnvironmentMapEffect after unbinding rendered black.

items.section: SwapInterval to VkPresentModeKHR: the same three-way switch Chapter ch:game-loop introduced
items.text: Vulkan did not override SetSwapInterval, so SynchronizeWithVerticalRetrace plus ApplyChanges could not change the present mode.

items.section: The 512-live-descriptor-set ceiling
items.text: Vulkan limited simultaneously live Texture2D plus RenderTarget2D objects to 512 (one fixed descriptor pool).

items.section: Coverage gap
items.text: No Vulkan-specific pixel tests for SpriteBatch sort/rotation/scale/crop/flip, SpriteFont placement or multi-mesh Model hierarchies.

items.section: METAL: a narrow implementation with explicit refusals
items.text: METAL refuses MRT, MSAA, custom effects, occlusion queries, instancing, multi-stream input and back-buffer readback.

items.section: METAL: a narrow implementation with explicit refusals
items.text: METAL's CI lane proves construction, clear/present and capability reporting but no representative 3D pixels.

items.section: Render targets, environment mapping, instancing, and mip generation
items.text: WebGPU regenerates plain Texture2D/TextureCube mips after every level-0 write, overwriting upper levels a game authored earlier; documented in source as a deliberate divergence from XNA/FNA.

items.section: Render targets, environment mapping, instancing, and mip generation
items.text: WebGPU's back buffer always has a Depth24PlusStencil8 attachment but PresentationParameters keeps the requested DepthFormat (no applied-format override), unlike Vulkan's VULKAN-348 write-back.

items.section: RenderTargetCube and its former silent cast failure
items.text: webgpu_rendertargetcube_test.cpp's header comment still describes mipMap=true as throwing and cube MSAA as reporting 0, contradicting its own current checks.

items.section: Verification methodology, and how it differs from D3D9's
items.text: WEBGPU is selected by no CI workflow; native evidence is Linux x86_64 only and browser evidence is scripted headless Chrome.

items.section: A bug a manual screenshot review missed, and a pixel assertion caught
items.text: WebGPU SpriteBatch blend factors did not match the shader's non-premultiplied output, rendering translucent sprites opaque.

items.section: 3D depth testing and the gap it exposed
items.text: WebGPU's depth-stencil apply entry point was unimplemented, so DepthStencilState did nothing.

items.section: The corrected render-target-size trap
items.text: WebGPU SpriteBatch positions were computed from the back buffer's size while a differently sized render target was bound.

items.section: RenderTargetCube and its former silent cast failure
items.text: Binding a RenderTargetCube as EnvironmentMapEffect.EnvironmentMap on WebGPU silently sampled the 1x1 white cube.

items.section: Render targets, environment mapping, instancing, and mip generation
items.text: WebGPU preferred an sRGB surface format, gamma-encoding SurfaceFormat::Color in the back buffer and render targets.

items.section: Why block-compressed texture upload remains open
items.text: No renderer uploaded block-compressed textures natively (ImageData RGBA8 only; DXT decompressed on load).

items.section: What remains open
items.text: WebGPU lacked MRT, stencil-operation baking, WireFrame, custom SpriteBatch effects and custom WGSL effects.

items.section: RenderTargetCube and its former silent cast failure
items.text: WebGPU RenderTargetCube refused mipMap=true and ignored MultiSampleCount (reported 0).

items.section: What remains open
items.text: WebGPU was native wgpu-native only; browser WebGPU out of scope.

items.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
items.text: The shared .cnj GLSL ES 3.00 effect fixture is not accepted by SDL_GPU's Vulkan-rule GLSL route; custom GLSL effects must use #version 450 with explicit locations and SDL_gpu sets.

items.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
items.text: CnjEffectTest.LoadsRealCnjFixture expects a valid effect on a renderer that reports CustomEffects, executes source and declares a non-HLSL dialect; under SDL_GPU with libshaderc that expectation conflicts with the renderer's rejection of GLSL ES 3.00 (not executed; whether CnaTests is run under SDL_GPU is not established).

items.section: What remains open
items.text: SDL_gpu 3.5.0 exposes no occlusion-query commands, so SDL_GPU refuses OcclusionQuery creation.

items.section: Verification methodology
items.text: SDL_GPU's Direct3D 12 and Metal driver routes have no native execution evidence (Direct3D 12 only via Wine/vkd3d-proton; Metal none); no workflow selects SDL_GPU.

items.section: SkinnedEffect's storage-buffer workaround and push-uniform limit
items.text: SDL_gpu's pushed-uniform limit (about 4,096 bytes measured on the Vulkan driver) forces SkinnedEffect's 4,608-byte palette into a texture.

items.section: The screenshot that exposed a Y-flip
items.text: SDL_GPU drew every sprite upside down because SDL_gpu's Vulkan driver flips clip-space Y.

items.section: Deferred rendering still preserves the game's draw order
items.text: SDL_GPU replayed every 3D family before every sprite regardless of the game's draw order.

items.section: A pre-release render-target use-after-free
items.text: Destroying a render target before SDL_GPU's deferred pass executed caused a use-after-free.

items.section: Texture3D's cycle=true orphaned-write defect
items.text: SDL_GPU Texture3D uploads used cycle=true and orphaned earlier sub-volume writes.

items.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
items.text: SDL_GPU violated SDL_gpu contracts (multisampled cube array; auto-mip without COLOR_TARGET; invalid 3D depth-plane views), hanging the Vulkan driver under validation.

items.section: What remains open
items.text: SDL_GPU reported the Instancing capability while DrawInstancedPrimitivesEx fell to the throwing default.

items.section: What remains open
items.text: SDL_GPU's CreateOcclusionQuery returned nullptr, which could make Begin/End silent no-ops.

items.section: Present timing belongs to the device manager, not a test-only renderer poke
items.text: GraphicsDevice::Reset did not forward the presentation interval to IGraphicsRenderer::SetSwapInterval on any renderer.

items.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
items.text: SDL_GPU stored the stencil reference without applying it (missing SDL_SetGPUStencilReference).

items.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
items.text: SDL_GPU captured DepthBias but omitted it from the snapshot and pipeline key, replaying every draw with zero bias.
